title: Canonical augmented ring-family models for locally equal ideals
statement: Let $(C,J,O)$ be a small ringed site, let $K,\epsilon,m$ be a specified strictly functorial augmented ring-complex family [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data], and let $f,g$ be finite lists of global sections of $O$. Suppose every object has a cover on which the section ideals $(f_i)$ and $(g_j)$ are equal. Their explicit sheaf models [def-weil-pbc-functorial-ring-complex-sheaf] are isomorphic as augmented complexes. On every sheafification-unit section where the ideals are equal, the isomorphism is transport of the ring-complex component along that equality of its ideal parameter.

proof.text: Equality of the section ideals is restriction-stable by ideal-map compatibility. Transport of a ring-family component along equality of its ideal is a linear equivalence. The same transports commute with restriction maps, differentials and augmentations, by substitution and proof irrelevance.

Apply the augmented local-equivalence sheafification theorem, with the equality locus and the component transports. The augmentation-unit equation follows from the sheafification adjunction; in degrees other than zero both presheaf augmentations vanish.

theorem ringFamilySheafModel_iso_of_locally_equal_ideals_with_unit (s : ℕ)
    (g : Fin s → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (h : ∀ X : C, ∃ S ∈ J X, ∀ (Y : C) (a : Y ⟶ X), S a →
      (ringFamilySectionIdeal O r f (op Y)).val =
        (ringFamilySectionIdeal O s g (op Y)).val) :
    ∃ z : (ringFamilySheafModel O K ε m hm r f).1 ≅
        (ringFamilySheafModel O K ε m hm s g).1,
      z.hom ≫ (ringFamilySheafModel O K ε m hm s g).2 =
        (ringFamilySheafModel O K ε m hm r f).2 ∧
        ∀ (n : ℤ) (X : Cᵒᵖ)
          (hX : ringFamilySectionIdeal O r f X = ringFamilySectionIdeal O s g X)
          (x : ((ringFamilyPresheafComplex O K ε m hm r f).X n).obj X),
          (z.hom.f n).val.app X
              (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
                (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O).obj)).unit.app
                  ((ringFamilyPresheafComplex O K ε m hm r f).X n)).app X x) =
            (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
              (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O).obj)).unit.app
                ((ringFamilyPresheafComplex O K ε m hm s g).X n)).app X
                  (ringFamilyComponentEquiv K (O.obj.obj X) _ _ hX n x))
